title: Toddler Boy Sitting on Snowy Porch Step, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photograph depicting a small toddler boy bundled up in winter outerwear including a dark knit cap, heavy coat, gloves, and boots. He sits quietly on a snow-dusted concrete step outside the front door of a brick home, holding something small in his mittened hands. The image offers a heartwarming glimpse into everyday suburban childhood during a snowy winter season in mid-century America.
